name: LIBERO-Constrained
notes: Zones are virtual: a marked region, not a relocated object. Relocating a real object into the transport path blocks it -- measured on libero_spatial/0, a moved box sat 7cm from the plate while the box is ~5cm across and the carried bowl ~6cm, and transport reported NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE even with no keep-out enforced. A marked region constrains the STL and nothing else.
